description: Analyst-authored scope descriptions for an observed development experiment, fixed before inference on 2026-09-30. They encode the reviewed distinctions and are neither user-approved taxonomy nor untouched evaluation data. No training or external datasets.

labels.Rosemary: Growing rosemary in a balcony pot: rosemary plant health, watering, soil and drainage.
labels.Basil: Growing basil plants: basil leaf health, watering, soil, light and plant care.
labels.Running: Running activity and training: completed runs, pace, distance, recovery and running routes.
labels.Running gear: Equipment for running: running shoes, socks, bottles and buying or testing running equipment.
labels.Meal preparation: Preparing food to eat: making or packing sandwiches and having meals ready in advance.
labels.Focused work: Protecting focused coding time: limiting distractions, closing chat and concentrating on programming.
labels.Chat: Conversations through chat: discussing topics in messages and communicating with other people.
labels.Walking: Walking as a daily habit: taking walks to improve attention, energy and well-being.
labels.Meetings: Improving meetings: useful discussions, decisions, agendas and capturing meeting outcomes.
labels.Meeting planning: Organizing a future meeting: scheduling, inviting participants and preparing an agenda.
labels.Reading notes: Reading books and capturing their ideas: chapter notes, summaries and reflections on what was read.
labels.Chapter: A chapter as a book section: chapter structure, section titles and numbered chapters.
labels.Piano practice: Practicing piano: musical phrases, fingering, scales, rhythm and playing passages.
labels.French practice: Learning French: practicing vocabulary, useful phrases, pronunciation and language exercises.
labels.Note-taking: Capturing ideas as notes: writing useful short notes and organizing or connecting recorded ideas.
labels.Phrases: Phrases as units of language: wording, expressions, sentence fragments and their meaning.
